note: Randolph County MO publishes no queryable parcel service found after search. Its official GIS viewer (randolphgis.breezemaps.com, gated by a disclaimer) is a BreezeMaps app with no ArcGIS REST endpoint (probe returned HTML). The assessor site (Vanguard/CAMA) links no parcel service. The only state ArcGIS parcel service (FMDCrealEstate_StateOwnedParcels) covers state-owned property only. Commercial parcel sellers (Regrid, Dynamo Spatial, Acres) are not county services.
